summary.text: Main bridges and crossroads become contested social and military objectives while evidence shows the Hollow Regent is engineering endless retaliation.

chapter.progressionIntent: Begins the long level-40-to-50 party and RvR progression without making side content mandatory.

summary.text: Secure a bridge objective, contest the central crossroads, and distinguish legitimate realm defense from attacks staged to feed the Veil.

text.text: Scout a bridge without triggering a false assault report.
Contest or defend the bridge objective through valid contribution.
Hold the crossroads long enough to inspect the buried signal array.
Expose the Veil array amplifying hatred and misinformation.

choice.meaning: Choose to fortify the bridge or leave a monitored passage for civilians; both preserve objective control and valid counterplay.

mainQuest.completionOutcome: The player earns warzone credibility, the first staged escalation network is destroyed, and a route toward the celestial rifts opens.

summary.text: Rescue stranded traders from several realms beneath an active objective without converting the rescue into a ceasefire exploit.

mainStoryContribution.text: Shows why neutral commerce is needed and foreshadows Accordant Isle while preserving the danger and rules of the warzone.

text.text: Locate the trapped traders without revealing the objective route.
Escort all willing traders to their separate realm exits.
A rescued trader helps establish the neutral market on Accordant Isle.

summary.text: Return a fallen rival unit's banner through a formal battlefield channel rather than displaying it as loot.

mainStoryContribution.text: Demonstrates that RvR conflict can remain serious without requiring contempt for the people on the other side.

text.text: Recover the banner before scavengers destroy it.
Verify the unit and avoid returning it to an impostor.
Complete the formal exchange under objective rules.
A rival commander later recognizes the champion and supports the temporary gem-custody accord.
